Rabbit fur texture appears smooth and plastic-like rather than realistic (severity 2). While the lighting and rendering quality are high, the fundamental geometry of the main subjects is flawed. The auxiliary mask image provided was largely black/empty, suggesting segmentation failure likely due to the complex fusion artifacts, which reinforces the authenticity concerns regarding object separation.
